# Woodstock Backup

> Woodstock Backup is a centralized backup solution with advanced deduplication and FUSE filesystem access. It features a Rust-based architecture with deduplication, plus native Windows compatibility without requiring SSH or rsync on client machines.

Woodstock Backup consists of multiple Rust crates (woodstock-rs core, client-rs daemon, cli-rs tools, shared-rs bindings) and modern web components (NestJS backend, Vue.js frontend). The system uses chunk-based deduplication, cryptographic verification, and provides both web interface and FUSE filesystem mounting for backup access.

## Core Components

- [Woodstock Core Library](woodstock-rs/Cargo.toml): Main Rust library with backup and storage logic
- [Client Daemon](client-rs/Cargo.toml): Rust-based client agent for backup operations
- [CLI Tools](cli-rs/Cargo.toml): Command-line utilities for backup management
- [Shared Components](shared-rs/Cargo.toml): Cross-language shared models and services

## Web Interface

- [NestJS Backend](nestjs/README.md): API server and GraphQL backend implementation
